items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: the last trip I made in '73, whenever it was, with the George Wein's company with the tribute to Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: I couldn't really see being so big.

Well, we flew -- the last trip I made in '73, whenever it was, with the George Wein's company with the tribute to Louis Armstrong, we flew from Moscow to Siberia, which is about one-third of the way across the country and which is as far as it was from Moscow to the United States, you know. God, took us something like ten hours to get there.
One city from Moscow, it would be like going from New York to California instead of like New York
